title: Footer, address and opening hours
description: Where to find you, when you are open and how to get in touch in three columns on a card-coloured background, then the site title, menu and privacy link. Stacks on small screens.

actions.label: Button
actions.description: A link to the address on a map (OpenStreetMap, Google Maps…), or to the contact page.

hours.label: Opening hours
hours.description: One line per day, or per run of days with the same hours, in week order: the days, then the times, such as “Monday to Friday: 8:00 – 18:00”.

privacy.label: Privacy link
privacy.description: A link to the privacy policy page.
